title: 入口专题 C4：主动关掉再点「问 AI」即开新会话（按 A5 分类表，只用 forceNew）+ 抽屉顶部改为标题、＋、历史图标
body:
epic:#5027#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMUfmNYTem26rXLFUf

Filing gate: ④ topic child. Source: topic #37853 (Jack: 「"页面里加按钮"的需求 作废」 06:28Z; card 「撤掉 ask_ai」 06:30Z; 「问 AI」 06:33Z; 「同意，立专题卡，非 cloud 的任务，让 objectstack #3 座位接手」 07:12Z, all 2026-11-27). Business reason: carried by the parent.
Parent: objectstack-ai/objectstack#37853 (rulings, target experience, card table, topic acceptance). Evidence: an independent Fable review of objectstack and cloud `main` (2026-11-27) checked every file:line below.
Owner: **repo:objectstack#3** (Jack 07:12Z 「非 cloud 的任务，让 objectstack #3 座位接手」). Reserved under topic #37853 (`pm:epic`), not `pm:queue`: other seats leave it.

Grading: area:ux · Task · p1 · size M–L.
Blocked-by: C0b (#37855) (A5 table); #37803 (split of `AiChatPage`, >3000 lines, waits for the maintainer's merge). Ships in the same release as C5.
Dedupe: searched `forceNew`, `drawer new conversation`: none open.

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：用户主动关掉抽屉再点「问 AI」就开新会话（手机自动收起、待确认计划等例外）；抽屉顶部改成会话标题 + ☆ + ＋ + 历史图标 + ⋯ + ×。
- 要你做什么：先合 #37803。

## Background (verified)
- The drawer reopens the last conversation; only `target.fresh` passes `forceNew` (no row until the first send) (`layout/ChatDockConversation.tsx:172-187`; `hooks/useChatConversation.ts:918-926,984-1042`).
- `resumeMode:'fresh'` reuses a conversation with zero server messages; a turn persists only when it ends, so **a generating conversation looks empty**. Do not use it.
- Mobile auto-collapses on answer-link taps and keeps the conversation (#37556, `layout/useConsoleChatDock.tsx:187-236`).
- Pending-approval marks are keyed by conversation id on the bus (`assistant/assistantBus.ts:171-249`).
- Header today: 「AI 助手」, a text 「历史」 button, ⋯, × (`layout/ChatDock.tsx:465-512,602-638`); the mobile sheet has its own header.
- Titles are auto-generated server-side from the first turn (cloud `service-ai/src/ai-service.ts:1263-1455`, can be off).

## What to do
1. In `useConsoleChatDock`, remember how the drawer last closed: user paths (toggle, collapse, ×) set a flag; the auto-collapse (`:229-233`) does not. On the next open with the flag set, target `{agent, fresh: true}` → `forceNew`. Implement every row of C0b (#37855)'s table (pending approval → that conversation; named targets, refresh, Studio `requestOpen()`, build/`packageId`, narrow↔full unchanged).
2. Header: title (「新会话」 before the first send; first-message summary when title generation is off, as the history list does); right side ＋ new conversation (current page record per C5), history as a clock icon button (keep `aria-pressed` and both names), ⋯ unchanged, ×. ☆ is added by C8. Same row on the mobile sheet, leaving room for its built-in ✕.
3. No new-chat shortcut in this phase (⌘⇧O is the browser's bookmark manager).
4. Update the #34827 title test to the new rule.

## Acceptance
- × then reopen → new; closed mid-generation then reopen → new, the old answer complete in history, no blank conversation; mobile auto-collapse then reopen → same; pending plan → that conversation.
- Refresh, `/ai/ask/<id>`, history → the named conversation; Home 「Ask AI」 → new; Studio copilot unchanged; `app.defaultAgent:'build'` apps follow A5's exception.
